prose: Krea 3 is presented as an image-editing model built for production use. The page claims it changes only what you ask, finishes an edit in about 8 seconds, and costs about $0.06 per image, positioned as many times faster and cheaper than GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro. These are the vendor's own claims.
highlights: Krea 3 image editor claims ~8s edits at ~$0.06 per image.
Speed and cost claims are the vendor's own.
